newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ retail sales trend shows 0.4 pct growth in Oct.
newsitem.headline: NZ retail sales trend shows 0.4 pct growth in Oct.

text.p: The underlying trend in retail sales indicates positive growth of 0.4 percent in October 1996, Statisitics New Zealand said on Tuesday.
Actual retail sales in October rose by 4.9 percent or NZ$152 million when compared with the October 1995 month to reach $3.240 billion.

SNZ said 11 of the 15 storetypes recorded increases over the last year with the fastest rates of growth in: recreational goods outlets, up 19.0 percent; hardware stores, up 14.4 percent; and accommodation, hotel and liquor outlets, up 9.1 percent.
